These are clarification questions, which per the criteria count as explicit statements only if they give a direct action. Here, the questions merely ask for explanations of methodological choices without suggesting any direct modification (e.g., increasing the number of frames or proposing alternative designs), so they do not constitute concrete actions. The authors are asked to 'explain why' but receive no guidance on how to act—whether to add frames, change the design, or justify the current setup—so the requested action remains vague on how to execute it. Therefore, this fits the criteria for a rating where an explicit action is stated but is vague on how to carry it out.
